source_limitations: Official Oxford 3000 by CEFR level PDF directly inspected via web text on 2026-10-29. PDF pages one-based; extracted web lines zero-based. This is word/POS CEFR evidence only, NOT exact-sense CEFR, independent English or fluent Myanmar verification, example grammar signoff or listening. No human-independent approvals. All proposals are unreviewed and unapplied; no audio, physical iPhone QA, hosting measurement or deployment. The 100/200 coverage is unique word/POS observations, not 100 reviewed words.
